paragraphs: Holmatro is a maker of high-pressure hydraulic technology, and states on its site that it has been working in that field for over 55 years. It describes what it creates as powerful solutions intended to make the world safer, healthier and more productive.
The site organizes that work by market, and the first one it names is fire and rescue. Law enforcement and military make up a second market on the list. Heavy lifting and transportation is a third.

The site is presented for more than one part of the world, with a regional choice that groups Europe, Asia and Latin America. Visitors are also asked to select a language. Products can be compared against each other on the site.
